lesson.subtitle: Lesson 16 -- Describing People and Places
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Rodrigo Luiz | Lesson 16 -- Describing People and Places
lesson.grammar_point: adjectives after to be and before the noun (she is friendly / a friendly leader)

listenings.text: Hi Rodrigo, it is Nora. Tomorrow at lunch you meet Sarah, from the lab. She is new in the team, and she is very friendly. She is tall, with long red hair and glasses. She is young, but she is very good at her job. The restaurant is small, and it is a little crowded at one o'clock. So look for a tall woman with red hair, at a table next to the window. Have a nice lunch!

Welcome to the West Village. This part of New York is old and very beautiful. The streets are small and quiet, with tall trees and red houses. It is not like Midtown: there are no tall glass buildings here. On the weekend it is crowded, with a lot of tourists, but on a Tuesday morning it is calm. There are many small restaurants and nice cafes. It is a great place for a long walk.

extra_audio.text: Nora opened the team page on her computer. First she showed Rodrigo a photo of Claire, the tall director from Paris. Then she talked about Tom, a funny man with a modern plant. Rodrigo asked about her office in a tall glass building. At the end Nora asked him about Sorocaba and his team.

reading.rtitle: Global Operations Team -- Who Is Who
paras: CLAIRE MARTIN, Global Operations Director, Paris. Claire is a serious but very friendly leader. She is tall, with short gray hair. She is from Lyon, a beautiful old city in France.
TOM WALSH, Plant Manager, New Jersey. Tom is a funny man with a big smile. His plant is small but very modern, and it is always clean.
NORA HAYES, Office Manager, New York. Nora is young and very organized. Her office is in a tall glass building in Midtown, a crowded and noisy part of the city.
KENJI SATO, Quality Manager, Tokyo. Kenji is quiet and serious in meetings, but he is very funny at dinner. His city is huge and modern, and the trains are never late.
New in the team: RODRIGO LUIZ, Operations Director, Brazil. Your profile is empty. Please send three adjectives about you, and two about your city.
